title: Does rain keep Britain at home?
excerpt: Every UK general election since 1945, seat by seat, against the rain that fell while the polls were open. Wetter seats saw turnout about 0.1 points lower per millimetre, but with only 22 elections that is not established, and there is no sign that rain helps any party.
seo_description: Rain while the polls were open at 22 UK general elections: turnout about 1.0 point lower per cm of rain, but not established. No partisan effect.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Does rain keep Britain at home?' beside a map of the UK with a dot for every constituency coloured by rain while the polls were open on 12 December 2019, most of England dark blue.
